rationale: The workflow is already minimal: a single job that runs only for dependabot[bot] on pull_request opened/reopened, with an existing 10-minute timeout and no dependency installation, matrix, tests, or scheduled triggers. No evidence-supported pattern has its preconditions met for this workflow. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT requires representative successful-duration history, but ci_history shows no completed runs, so an informed timeout budget cannot be chosen and reducing the existing timeout risks false timeouts. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE does not fit because the workflow does not re-run on pushes/synchronize, so there are no superseding runs to cancel. Caching patterns (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE, P-LIT-ENV-CACHE) have nothing to cache. Build/test selection, prioritization, and parallelism patterns have no build or test steps to modify. The existing timeout is already set, and no further optimization is supported by the evidence without weakening coverage or adding unsupported behavior.
